title: classify_nsfw output
description: A per-image adult-content decision. Scores are decision scores, not calibrated probabilities. The model is an adult-content classifier only: it makes no claim about minors and no claim about non-adult content.

isNSFW.description: True when score >= threshold under the selected policy.

score.description: The maximum score over the heads the policy counts, itself maxed over the scored crops.

threshold.description: The threshold the decision was made at.

quality.description: The crop set that was scored.

regions.description: Per-region scores in 0..1, each the maximum over the scored crops.

crops.description: Number of crops scored: 1 for fast, 4 for balanced, 8 for accurate.
